name: video-studio-page
title: Video Studio Page
description: A full video-studio page: top navigation, the studio settings panel as a left rail with Generate pinned to its foot, and a canvas showing the latest clip (or an empty state) above a strip of recent clips.

meta.use_when: You need the whole page where people set up a video clip (preset, references, duration, quality), generate it, and compare the latest takes on a large canvas.
